title: Universal Fourier-inertia bounds for prescribed even distances
summary: The study of set families with restricted Hamming distances is a classical topic of extremal combinatorics and coding theory. Let \(H=\{A\subseteq[n]: |A|\text{ is even}\}\) be the even subcube. Let \(\ell_1,\dots,\ell_t\) be distinct positive integers and set \(\mathcal L=\{2\ell_1,\dots,2\ell_t\}\). We prove that, for all sufficiently large \(n\), every family \(\mathcal F\subseteq H\) satisfying \( |A\triangle B|\in\mathcal L \) for all \(A\ne B\in\mathcal F\) has \[ |\mathcal F|\le \sum_{i=0}^{t}\binom{n-1}{i}. \] This is best possible as a universal bound, with equality attained at the…
